verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I spoke to Aaron and his sons, and to all the children of Israel. I said to them this: This is what the LORD has commanded.
verses.3: Every man from the house of Israel who kills an ox or a sheep in the field, or whoever kills something outside the field.
verses.4: And to the entrance of the altar, they did not bring there any sacrifice to be offered to Jehovah before His sanctuary. The blood was considered as the blood of that man who shed it. And that man was marked as belonging to his people.
verses.5: So that the children of Israel may bring their offerings, which they have offered in front of the altar. Then they shall bring them to the entrance of the tabernacle, to the priest, and the priest shall offer those offerings as sacrifices to God.
verses.6: And the priest sprinkled the blood on the altar of Jehovah. He also burned the milk as an aroma pleasing to Jehovah.
verses.7: And they shall not continue to worship their idols, those who they have worshipped as gods. This will be a law for them forever.
verses.8: And to them, say to each one of the people of Israel and to all those who live among them: “Come forward and offer your sacrifices.”
verses.9: And at the entrance to the tent of the priest, he will not be allowed to perform that duty for Jehovah. And that man will be marked as belonging to his own people.
verses.10: And every man from the house of Israel, and also those who were foreigners among them, who ate any kind of blood, I will make their faces turn into something like those of those who eat blood. I will recognize them as belonging to their people.
verses.11: For the soul of the dead is in blood. And I have given it to you to be placed upon the altar, so that it may bear witness against your souls. For the blood is what bears witness against them.
verses.12: Therefore, I said to the children of Israel: “Not a single person among you shall eat blood. And no Gentile who lives among you shall eat blood either.”
verses.13: And every man among the Israelites, and also those foreigners who lived among them, whoever had meat or drink that was not clean, or whoever spilled blood and covered it with dirt…
verses.14: For the soul of every living creature is like his own soul. He said to the children of Israel, “Do not eat the blood of any living creature.” For the soul of every living creature is like its own soul; all its food will be unclean.
verses.15: And every living being that eats worms and insects on the land and in the trees, and which wets itself with its own waste, and swims in the water, will be purified until morning.
verses.16: And if it cannot be carried, and its tongue cannot lick it, then it will be left to rot.
